description:
The fz-acn payoff. Interpreted entry dispatch (src/ir_interp/backend.rs select_clause) and the interpreted guard call edge walk the plan graph with two fresh HashSets on every call; native lowering (jobs/native.rs lower_clause_dispatch_executable, lower_dispatch_call_edge) and executable facts walk it at compile time; keying (jobs/keying.rs local_dispatch_mask) walks the matrix arms, dead arms included, plus every guard, per function per root. 19.6% of interpreter samples on tail_recursion; that lane trips CI's 20s guard on loaded runners (run 34893795875 on the fz-acn.2 push, whose diff does not touch the per-call path and whose local timing equals main's).

The fact: DispatchGraph carries input_demand: Vec<DispatchDemand>, one slot per declared input; the producer's finish passes the declared count to compile_dispatch_matrix. It rides map_type_handle and derives equality with the graph; canon does not render it (derived from what canon already renders).

Where it accrues: DispatchGraphBuilder::add_node, the single funnel. A Test node charges its predicate (subject chain -> root ordinal and path, demand_for_region -> shape, demand_at_path -> nesting); Equal(Pinned) also charges the pin's input whole; a bitstring shape charges each BitstringFieldSize::Pinned field's input whole; Region::Guard charges the guard's leaves and never its carrier subject. Fail and Outcome nodes charge nothing. Every Test and Outcome node the builder creates is reachable from the root (only Fail can be orphaned and it reads nothing), so accrual at creation equals the reachable walk.

Handed to the builder as plain data: the pins' resolved inputs (fz-acn.2) and a per-guard leaf list (Subject(id) | Pinned(id)), accrued while guard_expr_from_ast builds the expression through an out-parameter threaded like prepared_keys; a nested helper call contributes only its argument expressions. The leaf table lives on the producer and is dropped after compile.

Evidence projections are NOT charged, as an invariant: a projection is a binding, not a question, and every projection sits under a structural test on its source, so its root already carries a non-Ignore demand. The builder asserts this at each node. Charging bindings would raise keying's demand for every destructured head.

Answers that change, all toward the truth: arms after a catch-all never become nodes (00151, 00152: keying stops marking dead heads); a guard no longer charges input 0 as a placeholder (drive_test pin [Whole, Ignore, Whole] -> [Ignore, Ignore, Whole]; every guarded function whose guard does not read input 0 loses a spurious whole demand there; this is the one change that can move activation keying through closure-brand erasure and convergence collapse: the census ratchets and the guard fixtures on three doors are the signal, and any movement is explained, not re-blessed); a zero-arity guarded clause stops panicking (fz-acn.8 adds the fixture).

Deleted: the whole walk family in compiler2/artifact.rs (method, free function, six collectors); jobs/keying.rs local_dispatch_mask, mark_predicate_inputs, mark_subject_demand, mark_guard_inputs (demand_for_region and the subject chain fold move into the builder); the re-export at compiler2/mod.rs; the HashSet results at every reader; ExecutableFacts::entry_dispatch_inputs as a stored set. Readers: backend.rs select_clause and the CallEdge::Dispatch path, native.rs both lowerings, executable_facts.rs, keying.rs:418 into DemandNode.local, all read the slice or test a slot.

No new telemetry event: fz.compiler2.entry_dispatch.defined already counts plan definitions per run byte-identically (24 on tail_recursion), and DispatchCompileStats is test-only. The proof that nothing walks at runtime is that the fold is private to the builder.

Tests: producer-level, each named for its intent: count/2 records [Whole, Ignore]; a guarded head with a wildcard first parameter leaves it Ignore; a lambda head pinning a capture charges the capture's input; a pinned bitstring size charges its pin; a head after a catch-all charges nothing. The lane-form tests in backend.rs and native.rs and the two drive tests move from HashSet to slice. A fz2_cli census pin for tail_recursion's entry_dispatch.defined count. Corroborating: tail_recursion interp wall time loses the walk's fifth.

Docs: .agent/docs/semantic-authorities.md "What a dispatch plan demands" rewritten around the recorded fact; fact-engine.md names the accessor; pattern-matching.md's payload list and dispatch-matrix.md's builder section describe accrual at add_node.
title: The graph records input_demand at add_node; delete both scanners and the interpreter's per-call walk
